properties.source: USACE IENC layer 46 RECOMMENDED_TRACK_LINE (Primary Sailing Line)

honest_caveats: Channel = USACE IENC 'Primary Sailing Line' for the deep-water tow route; recreational boats routinely leave this line for shallower water.

River-mile values are computed via cumulative arc-length along the channel, calibrated at a 6-point anchor axis (below Alma, Alma, Reads Landing, Frontenac, Red Wing, above Red Wing), accurate to ~0.5 RM and guaranteed monotonic by construction. Refresh anchors if you need tighter alignment.
Rebuild by refetching layer 46 for the same bbox and rerunning this script; USACE republishes monthly with LNM updates.
